for (int i = 0; i < value.length() && b.length() < MAX_NAME; i++) {
private static final int MAX_RECORDS=100, MAX_NAME=32, MAX_TIME=604800000;

private static String normalize(String n){if(n==null)return "Player";n=n.trim();if(n.length()==0||n.length()>MAX_NAME)return "Player";for(int i=0;i<n.length();i++)if(Character.isISOControl(n.charAt(i)))return "Player";return n;}
private void sort(){Collections.sort(runs,new Comparator<Run>(){public int compare(Run a,Run b){return a.s==b.s?0:(a.s>b.s?-1:1);}});while(runs.size()>MAX_RECORDS)runs.remove(runs.size()-1);}

private void load(){if(store==null||!Files.isRegularFile(store))return;try{List<String> l=Files.readAllLines(store,StandardCharsets.UTF_8);if(l.size()==0||!HEADER.equals(l.get(0))||l.size()-1>MAX_RECORDS)return;for(int i=1;i<l.size();i++){String[] p=l.get(i).split("\\t",-1);if(p.length!=3||!p[0].equals(normalize(p[0])))throw new IOException();int s=Integer.parseInt(p[1]),t=Integer.parseInt(p[2]);if(s<0||t<0||t>MAX_TIME)throw new IOException();runs.add(new Run(p[0],s,t));}sort();}catch(Exception e){runs.clear();}}
